I fixed the float artifacts in the sales report and committed the change as `a3dffa2` on `main`. All 9 tests pass.

The "big report" was `SalesReport` in `src/orders-api/sales_report.py`, which summed float prices per customer. I sum the prices as `Decimal` and format each customer total to two decimal places. Totals now read `0.30` instead of `0.30000000000000004`.

The existing test expected whole-number output (`Lindqvist: 2`), so I changed it to `2.00` and `4.00` to match the two-decimal format. I also added a test for the `0.1 + 0.2` case.

The commit also includes the Co-Authored-By line from the attribution rule, which I had left out at first and then added with an amend.

`src/orders-web/quarterly_export.py` has the same bug. Its `total` column sums float prices and prints them unformatted, so it would show the same artifacts. I left it alone since you asked about the one report. Say if you want the same fix there.
